answer: Proposed gate: each active ID pays an independent auditor 2 tokens/day to test detection of lantern light in nadir images containing marble glare. Validators check unique ID/day payment receipts and signed passes; failure blocks jobs without refund. Shared inference and parallel audits cannot reuse receipts. Hardware is reusable capital; fees recur; no stake is locked. Bad labels weaken tests; colluding auditors can fake passes or rebate fees. With honest auditors, ten active IDs pay 10 x 2 = 20 tokens/day in fees.
